coverage.association: exact original metadata request and raw-reply evidence digest
coverage.chunks: each metadata hash admits once in any order, including actual empty chunks
coverage.complete: every exact region size and chunk covered; zero-size regions need no read
coverage.failures: coverage unchanged on rejection; reconstruction starts empty, never resumes or resets spending
coverage.grants: no byte custody, durable artifact, authenticated origin, backend transfer, accounting, dispatch or terminal/release
coverage.ranges: each region starts at zero and advances contiguously; regions may interleave; gaps, overlaps and duplicates reject
coverage.state: ephemeral three nat64 region cursors and at most 1024 chunk-presence bits; no data retained

golden_registry.construction: independent DIDL, field hashes, LEB128, nat64 and SHA-256; every registered case tested

grants: no aggregate transfer/progress, complete artifact, fresh permission, spending, receipt, retry/reconciliation, upload/load/start or terminal/release

hashing.body: retained metadata evidence hash, exact request hash, raw reply hash; each 64 lowercase ASCII hex bytes

integration_owned: fresh read access, original per-call spending and proof of no prior dispatch
stable complete artifact bytes, durable transfer and authentic capture
upload/load safety, custody and terminal/release admission
kind: ephemeral metadata-bound request/reply codec; no persisted record, progress or provider

reply.chunks: SHA-256 of actual bytes equals exact requested hash; empty known chunks allowed
reply.diagnostics: typed errors and Debug omit raw bytes, arguments and snapshot/hash identifiers
reply.ranges: actual byte length equals exact requested size
reply.wire: exactly one record with required chunk blob; no skipped fields, extra arguments or trailing bytes

request.chunks: exact 32-byte hash present in retained metadata; no offset or fallback identity
request.hash_owner: existing management payload digest; metadata excluded from nonrecursive wire hash
request.metadata: borrow exact admitted metadata reply and its canonical target/raw snapshot ID
request.ranges: Wasm module, Wasm heap or stable memory: nonzero bounded size, checked offset+size <= retained region size

unchanged: existing lifecycle/recovery enums/records, metadata owner, request hash, journals, manifests, attempts and source references
